summary: The Read Restrictions Sync notes for 1 September 2026 list two items and record no discussion. A vote is in progress on the mailing list and people were asked to take part. The second item is the implementation strategy for the spec. On the client side it lists Iceberg Java (Actions API, REST scaffolding, Iceberg Generics, and with question marks Spark with extensions and Trino), PyIceberg and Iceberg Rust. On the server side it lists RCK and an open slot.
